description: Compare two full binary trees' left-to-right leaf-label sequences with lockstep explicit-stack iterators.

source.title: On the static and dynamic extents of delimited continuations

input.encoding: [nA,nB, recordsA..., recordsB...], each local node record is [value,left_child,right_child], roots are local node 0, and child -1 means absent

output.encoding: 1 if leaf labels match in left-to-right order, 0 if they differ, -1 for malformed framing or a malformed tree

contract.tree_shape: Each tree is a full binary tree: a leaf has both children equal to -1; an internal node has two distinct child indices in 0..n-1. Unary nodes are invalid. Internal-node values are ignored; leaf values are signed i64 labels.
contract.structure_validation: The root is node 0. Every node must be reachable exactly once, root 0 must have no parent, every other node exactly one parent, and cycles/shared children are invalid. The two node tables are disjoint and child indices are local to each table.
contract.algorithm: Validate both node tables. Initialize one stack with each root. Each iterator pops a node, yields a leaf label when at a leaf, or pushes right then left child. Compare yielded labels one pair at a time and stop at the first mismatch; equal output requires both iterators to exhaust together.
contract.independent_method: The independent reference recursively validates each tree and fully collects its left-to-right leaf list, then compares the two lists.
contract.invalid_cases: Null input, fewer than two header words, more than 93 parseable words, invalid node counts, non-exact frame length, invalid child markers/indices, unary nodes, duplicate child edges, cycles, shared children, unreachable records, or invalid root parent counts return -1.
contract.distinction: flatten_nested_list flattens a nested-list input and returns a leaf-sequence hash. This profile compares two independent binary trees' leaf streams lockstep, returns only whether they are equal, and stops leaf comparisons at the first mismatch.
contract.validation_note: Structural validation visits every node before comparison; after validation, the lockstep iterator avoids building either complete leaf list and stops leaf-value comparisons at the first mismatch.

complexity.primary_time: O(nA+nB) for full structural validation and at most O(nA+nB) iterator work; mismatching leaf streams stop value comparisons at their first differing leaf.
complexity.primary_space: One reused 15-entry validation stack, visited flags, and parent counts, plus two 15-entry iterator stacks and scalar state; capped at 1024 bytes.
complexity.independent_time: O(nA+nB) recursive validation and complete leaf collection.
complexity.independent_space: At most 15 visited-node markers and 15 parent counts per tree, eight leaf labels per tree, and recursion state; Python runtime object overhead is reference-only and outside the native workspace cap.
